name: Instruction For Cheque Agent 1
definition: Further information related to the processing of the cheque instruction that may need to be acted upon by the receiving agent.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Coded information related to the processing of the cheque, intended for the receiving agent.

InstructionInformation.name: Instruction Information
InstructionInformation.definition: Further information complementing the coded instruction or instruction to the cheque agent that is bilaterally agreed or specific to a user community.
